title_en: Great Poems and Songs (15/20): Du Mu, Poet of the River and the Past
note_en: 一边……一边…… describes two actions happening at the same time: 一边欣赏风景，一边思考历史 "enjoy the scenery and reflect on history at the same time." English often uses "while" or "at the same time," but Chinese puts 一边 in front of each verb, so the two actions get equal weight.

sentences.en: Tradition also credits Du Mu with the widely known poem "Qingming": "A steady drizzle falls at Qingming time; travelers on the road are sick at heart. I ask where I might find a tavern—a cowherd boy points far off to Apricot Blossom Village." In just four lines it moves from the endless drizzle to the travelers' sorrow, then to a question and answer, building step by step like a little movie scene.
